findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context discards the mutated config copy
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds `config = monitor_environment.monitor.config.copy()` and replaces the numeric `schedule_type` with its human-readable display value, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, unmodified dict) for the `"config"` key. As a result the monitor context attached to the issue occurrence event still carries the raw integer `schedule_type` and the copy/display-name work is dead code. Since this code was just moved into a new module it is a good moment to fix it: return `config` instead of `monitor_environment.monitor.config`.

findings.title: Docstring example cannot be produced by get_failure_reason
findings.body: The docstring for `get_failure_reason` lists `"A failed check-in was detected"` as an example output, but the function can only return the strings from `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` (error/missed/timeout) or the pluralized `"... check-ins detected"` form. The example is misleading for anyone relying on the docstring to know the possible outputs. Also note that when `failed_checkins` contains no statuses in `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, `status_counts` is empty and the function returns the bare string "check-ins detected" with an empty prefix, which the docstring does not describe.

findings.title: Public helpers renamed/relocated without updating any callers or tests
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` -> `try_incident_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` -> `create_incident_occurrence` were moved out of `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` into new modules, and `SimpleCheckIn` moved to `sentry.monitors.types`. No other file in this PR was updated. Any remaining import or `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")` style reference (tests commonly patch these paths) will now raise `AttributeError`/`ImportError` at runtime, or worse, silently stop patching the real code path. Worth grepping for the old names/paths and updating them (or re-exporting from `mark_failed`) before merge.
